fullName: Hotel Booking Validation Suite: Negative Validation Flow - Negative_Missing_Email

steps.name: Given I navigate to the MakeMyTrip homepage
When I dismiss the login popup and click on the hotels module
And I search for the hotel destination "Bangalore"
And I trigger the search query
And I apply the 5-star filter on the results page
And I select the first hotel and click Book Now
And I submit the form with invalid or missing data for "Negative_Missing_Email"
Then the system should enforce validation rules based on "Negative_Missing_Email"
